title: Register Child Birth Online via NADRA Pak ID App
excerpt: Parents in Pakistan can now use the NADRA Pak ID mobile application to register their child's birth from home with local authorities.
body_html:
Parents located in Pakistan are now able to complete the birth registration process for their children from the comfort of their homes. According to recent updates, the procedure can be handled online through the NADRA Pak ID application.

Using the official mobile app, families can connect with the relevant local authority to submit the necessary birth registration details without needing to visit an office in person.
